entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: The pressure on us is insane.[n]It's not showing any signs[n]of calming down either...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It looks like people are sick of[n]waiting for us to take action.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hard mode engaged.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That don't matter! We ain't got[n]a choice but to do this now!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Will you be OK, Haru?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Yes, thank you.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'd be lying if I said I'm not[n]a little anxious though...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We do have only three days[n]until the deadline.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Unless we locate the Treasure[n]today, we're going to run out of[n]time.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Right.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We'll need time to send the calling[n]card as well... Either way, we'll[n]need to hurry up.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sounds like we're going to the[n]Palace today, then. Lemme know[n]when we're heading out!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yusuke's right. We're out of time.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We're gonna change Okumura's heart,[n]right? Let's get out there and find his[n]Treasure!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We must send the calling card with[n]all due haste, or we won't have[n]enough time to finish this.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's just send it today.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We should definitely meet at the[n]hideout and discuss it, at least.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Okay. Call us over when you're[n]ready!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All that's left is for us to send the calling[n]card. Ryuji's right--we should just do it[n]now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We gotta make sure we change[n]Okumura's heart.
